prompt:
New original fantasy card art, input reference for pixel style only. ONE 1536×1024 landscape sheet with EXACT 3 equal columns and 2 equal rows, six independent square panels and narrow black separators at the exact thirds and half. Crisp hand-clustered square pixels, limited local colors, believable depth and occlusion. Compose each scene around a distinct large and easily recognized silhouette, main objects and contact points completely inside central 65% height and 85% width of their panel. Breathe around outlines, logically attached parts, defined scale, props supported unless specifically magical. Change perspective and key colors between scenes. No modern hardware, no labels or legible letters. Follow exact reading order. This is a fantasy priest's relic series: matching cream parchment, granite idols, stone devotional places, and a single legible light or shadow motif in each tile.
Top left. Rolled pale parchment lies on the base of a weathered small roadside idol. One warm light path curls from the parchment up three clearly visible slate steps through a bright birch woodland. Diagonal landscape depth, ochre and jade.
Top middle. A single old parchment secured by a visible purple wax seal rests on gray stone. One sparse forked ribbon of dark magic grows out of its seal toward a separate chipped ivory pebble, daylight falling away in plum tones, physically distinct objects.
Top right. One distinctly identifiable half-unrolled cream parchment on blue gray granite. One solid gold glowing flower bud opens just above its middle, clearly separated from the paper. Honey light, few surroundings and simple central closeup.
Bottom left. Low side view of a small squat stone attendant taking one step out of a bright ground fissure near a large stony statue foot. A clearly recognizable cream scroll with two rolled ends rests on a wide ledge immediately beside it. Olive daylight, chalk and gold.
Bottom middle. Diagonal aerial shot of three compact stone idols standing on their own round plinths, in a clear triangle. One copper-orange thrust from each converges on one open flagstone at center and one wide spark burst. Red clay shrine, full figures small, simple negative space.
Bottom right. Low oblique view inside a recessed shrine. Three small distinct standing idols stand apart, each sends one separate violet shadow along the floor; the shadow paths converge in one dark burgundy knot. Cobalt mist farther back, no glyph overload.
